cases.setup: mkdir -p d/sub/deep d/empty d/.hid d/sub/more/inner; printf hello > d/a.txt; printf x > d/sub/b.txt; head -c 1000 /dev/zero > d/sub/deep/big.bin; : > d/.hid/note; printf 'twelve bytes' > d/sub/more/a.txt; : > d/zero

cases.name: hidden files and deep files
cases.setup: mkdir -p d/.a/b; printf 123 > d/.a/b/c; printf 45 > d/.x

cases.name: a big file (more than 2 MB)
cases.setup: mkdir d; head -c 3000000 /dev/zero > d/big; printf x > d/small

cases.name: many files
cases.setup: mkdir d; for i in $(seq 1 200); do printf 1234567890 > d/f$i; done

cases.name: missing directory
cases.stdout:
dusum: nope: No such file or directory
rc=1
